## DESCRIPTION
PromptFluid is an applied AI company building autonomous systems, infrastructure tooling, and experimental interfaces. We specialize in cognitive orchestration substrates that provide routing, memory, learning cycles, observability, and defense for AI systems. Our approach is model-agnostic and provider-agnostic, running on commodity cloud infrastructure.

## CORE PRODUCTS (6 Live)

### 1. Defense
- Category: Security
- Description: AI-powered WordPress bot detection and threat prevention
- Use Case: Protect WordPress sites from automated attacks, credential stuffing, and malicious bots
- Technology: Behavioral fingerprinting, ML-based threat scoring

### 2. Clarity
- Category: Accessibility
- Description: Automated WCAG 2.2 accessibility compliance scanner
- Use Case: Ensure websites meet accessibility standards, identify and fix WCAG violations
- Technology: Automated scanning, AI-powered fix recommendations

### 3. Brain
- Category: AI Infrastructure
- Description: Multi-provider AI orchestration gateway
- Use Case: Route AI requests across providers, manage costs, ensure reliability
- Technology: Intelligent routing, failover, load balancing

### 4. Modernizer
- Category: Web Development
- Description: Legacy website to modern React conversion
- Use Case: Transform outdated websites into modern, performant React applications
- Technology: AI-powered code generation, design extraction

### 5. Cascade

### 6. Marketing
